design: All76 equal-length H843 competent task pairs, both directions, all5 families. At each18 raw preMLP sites transplant all identical-token/index positions, or identical-token positions excluding final position. Token-different positions never edited. Recipient original embeddings and persistent values unchanged.
early_models: At sites1/2 also exact donor normalizedshape with recipient radius, and all five frozen H836 architectures/both seeds: recipient shape + decoded donor-minus-recipient reconstruction, then normalize and restore recipient radius. Token mean cancels exactly at every edited position, including global fallback. Keep recipient reconstruction error.
interpretation: Same-token/index difference reflects upstream context. Simultaneous multi-position intervention need not identify a single feature. Reused exploratory task panel; no outcomes-based filtering or retraining. Deeper sweep localizes positive controls; early fits not transported to different sites.
audits: Manual native runner comparison; all-site identity on first batch; same-token assertion; prefix-before-first-difference state equality; no reserved-test.
